name: Frankfurt (Oder, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Frankfurt (Oder) (a red cockerel between two red towers on white), overlapping the middle stripe.
history: Municipal flag of Frankfurt (Oder); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Frankfurt (Oder) arms — red cockerel and towers on white
